name: quenching
description: OKF knowledge, provider-owned specs, DTCG design, automation, and git workflows for Claude Code. The design front keeps /.design/tokens.json as one DTCG 2025.10 source, emits PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, the Impeccable sidecar, and HTML/Typst adapters, and imports external DESIGN.md proposals only after explicit human arbitration. Three local fronts align in dependency order under /align; Impeccable is an optional web consumer. Forty-one commands, one file per entry point, uniform --json payloads, and strict exit codes.
